claims.title: Rise of Funan
claims.summary: Funan emerges around the Mekong delta as the first major Hinduized kingdom of Southeast Asia, prospering on maritime trade between India and China.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1-rise-of-funan, claim TL:KHM:event:1:rise-of-funan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Chenla supplants Funan
claims.summary: Chenla, ruled by princes descended from the kings of Funan, absorbs Funan's territory and becomes the dominant power in the region.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-500-chenla-supplants-funan, claim TL:KHM:event:500:chenla-supplants-funan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Fragmentation of Chenla
claims.summary: Chenla splits into a Land Chenla and a Water Chenla and loses cohesion, leaving the Khmer lands divided on the eve of the Angkorian unification.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-700-fragmentation-of-chenla, claim TL:KHM:event:700:fragmentation-of-chenla, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Jayavarman II founds the Khmer Empire
claims.summary: Jayavarman II is consecrated as devaraja and universal ruler on Mahendraparvata, asserting Khmer independence and inaugurating the empire of Angkor.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-802-jayavarman-ii-founds-the-khmer-empire, claim TL:KHM:event:802:jayavarman-ii-founds-the-khmer-empire, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Suryavarman II and Angkor Wat
claims.summary: Suryavarman II reunites the empire and begins Angkor Wat, dedicated to Vishnu and the largest religious structure in the world, completed after his death.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1113-suryavarman-ii-and-angkor-wat, claim TL:KHM:event:1113:suryavarman-ii-and-angkor-wat, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Jayavarman VII rebuilds Angkor Thom and the Bayon
claims.summary: After repelling a Cham invasion, Jayavarman VII embraces Mahayana Buddhism, expands the empire to its greatest extent, and builds Angkor Thom and the Bayon.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1181-jayavarman-vii-rebuilds-angkor-thom-and-the, claim TL:KHM:event:1181:jayavarman-vii-rebuilds-angkor-thom-and-the, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Thai capture of Angkor
claims.summary: After repeated Tai attacks, Angkor is captured in 1431 and subsequently abandoned as a capital, marking the end of the imperial era.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1431-thai-capture-of-angkor, claim TL:KHM:event:1431:thai-capture-of-angkor, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: French protectorate established
claims.summary: King Norodom signs a treaty placing Cambodia under French protection to fend off Siamese and Vietnamese pressure; Siam acknowledges the protectorate by 1867.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1863-french-protectorate-established, claim TL:KHM:event:1863:french-protectorate-established, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Cambodia joined to French Indochina
claims.summary: Cambodia is incorporated into the colonial federation of French Indochina, its monarchy preserved as a figurehead while the French administer the country.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1887-cambodia-joined-to-french-indochina, claim TL:KHM:event:1887:cambodia-joined-to-french-indochina, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Japan ends French rule; Sihanouk proclaims independence
claims.summary: Japan removes the French administration in the closing months of the war, and King Sihanouk briefly proclaims Cambodian independence before France returns.

sources.label: Cambodia: World War II and its aftermath

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1945-japan-ends-french-rule-sihanouk-proclaims, claim TL:KHM:event:1945:japan-ends-french-rule-sihanouk-proclaims, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Full independence declared
claims.summary: After Sihanouk's Royal Crusade for Independence, France transfers sovereignty and King Norodom Sihanouk declares Cambodia's full independence in Phnom Penh.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1953-full-independence-declared, claim TL:KHM:event:1953:full-independence-declared, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Lon Nol coup and the Khmer Republic
claims.summary: While Sihanouk is abroad, the National Assembly removes him and Lon Nol takes power, abolishing the monarchy, proclaiming the Khmer Republic, and joining the war on the U.S. side.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1970-lon-nol-coup-and-the-khmer-republic, claim TL:KHM:event:1970:lon-nol-coup-and-the-khmer-republic, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Khmer Rouge capture Phnom Penh
claims.summary: Pol Pot's Khmer Rouge seize the capital, empty the cities, rename the country Democratic Kampuchea, and abolish money, markets, religion, and private life.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1975-khmer-rouge-capture-phnom-penh, claim TL:KHM:event:1975:khmer-rouge-capture-phnom-penh, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Cambodian genocide
claims.summary: Under the Khmer Rouge an estimated 1.5 to 3 million people, about a quarter of the population, die from execution, forced labour, starvation, and disease.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1975-the-cambodian-genocide, claim TL:KHM:event:1975:the-cambodian-genocide, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Vietnamese intervention ends the regime
claims.summary: Vietnam invades Cambodia, captures Phnom Penh in January 1979, ousts the Khmer Rouge, and ends the genocide, beginning a decade-long occupation.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1978-vietnamese-intervention-ends-the-regime, claim TL:KHM:event:1978:vietnamese-intervention-ends-the-regime, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Paris Peace Agreements signed
claims.summary: The Cambodian factions sign the Paris Agreements on a Comprehensive Political Settlement, ending the war and delegating transitional authority to the United Nations.

sources.label: Agreement on a Comprehensive Political Settlement of the Cambodia Conflict (Paris Agreement, 1991)
United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia (UNTAC)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1991-paris-peace-agreements-signed, claim TL:KHM:event:1991:paris-peace-agreements-signed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: UNTAC mission
claims.summary: The UN Transitional Authority in Cambodia repatriates over 300,000 refugees and organizes national elections, one of the largest peacekeeping operations of its era.

sources.label: United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia (UNTAC)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1992-untac-mission, claim TL:KHM:event:1992:untac-mission, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Constitutional monarchy restored
claims.summary: UN-supervised elections produce a new constitution restoring the kingdom, and Norodom Sihanouk returns to the throne as constitutional monarch.

sources.label: United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia (UNTAC)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1993-constitutional-monarchy-restored, claim TL:KHM:event:1993:constitutional-monarchy-restored, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Death of Pol Pot and collapse of the Khmer Rouge
claims.summary: The Khmer Rouge insurgency disintegrates and Pol Pot dies, ending the movement responsible for the genocide of the 1970s.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1998-death-of-pol-pot-and-collapse-of-the-khmer-rouge, claim TL:KHM:event:1998:death-of-pol-pot-and-collapse-of-the-khmer-rouge, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Cambodia joins ASEAN
claims.summary: Cambodia becomes a member of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, marking its reintegration into regional and international affairs after decades of war and isolation.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-1999-cambodia-joins-asean, claim TL:KHM:event:1999:cambodia-joins-asean, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Opposition dissolved, CPP entrenched
claims.summary: With the main opposition party dissolved by the courts, Hun Sen's Cambodian People's Party wins every National Assembly seat, consolidating one-party dominance.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-2018-opposition-dissolved-cpp-entrenched, claim TL:KHM:event:2018:opposition-dissolved-cpp-entrenched, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Khmer Rouge tribunal concludes
claims.summary: The UN-backed Extraordinary Chambers in the Courts of Cambodia convicts senior Khmer Rouge leaders of crimes against humanity and genocide before concluding its work.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-2022-khmer-rouge-tribunal-concludes, claim TL:KHM:event:2022:khmer-rouge-tribunal-concludes, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Hun Manet succeeds his father
claims.summary: After 38 years in power, Hun Sen hands the premiership to his son Hun Manet, who is sworn in on 22 August 2023 in a dynastic succession.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Cambodia: Heir to Angkor and the Khmer Empire, scarred by genocide, reborn as a constitutional kingdom under the shadow of one family's long rule.", terralore.co/country/KHM/chronicle#ev-2023-hun-manet-succeeds-his-father, claim TL:KHM:event:2023:hun-manet-succeeds-his-father, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
